notes: Synthetic fresh database, not a sanitized production database.
Bots and server share this host; not a production capacity guarantee.
Serial forest/champions runs with matched geometry/HP/damage/respawn and ordinary gameplay guards.
Map reward policies remain their real policies, including the default 2% crown chance.
Functional checks do not certify latency performance.
Channel p95/p99 are maximum per-channel percentiles in each run, not a pooled population percentile.
Main and channel timer gaps are separately reported; they may overlap and must not be added as unique physical freezes.
Cgroup throttling deltas cover startup, timed workload and drain, not only the timed window.
RSS is the conservative sum of per-process high-water marks.
Four-CPU shared-host synthetic fixture is not the eight-core production VDS; no production capacity or zero-lag guarantee.
